# Get Blogged by JoKi - Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base
> The only frontiers are in your mind

Author: Jochen Kirstätter (Microsoft MVP for Developer Technologies, Google Developer Expert for Cloud & AI)
Website: https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/
Contact: jochen@kirstaetter.name
Location: Flic en Flac, Mauritius

---

## Agent Instructions & When to Use This Site

### Best-Fit Use Cases
- Resolving .NET & C# engineering problems, package development, and performance optimization.
- Integrating Google Gemini API and Vertex AI in .NET using `Mscc.GenerativeAI` and typed `ResponseSchema`.
- Implementing static site workflows with DocFX, custom templates, and Firebase Hosting.
- Reviewing developer tools like Google Antigravity (Remote Control on mobile), Portless HTTPS proxy, and Docker on GCP.
- Discovering tech events and IT community initiatives in Mauritius (MSCC, Developers Conference).

### Consumption Format
- Raw Markdown files for each article can be retrieved at `https://jochen.kirstaetter.name/raw/<slug>.md`.
- Content negotiation with `Accept: text/markdown` is fully supported on the site.
